W~.text: PUBLIC API • id 1–8. Call once to create; call again with the same id to animate new targets. Full width/height in stage pixels. Shape: 1/rounded rectangle, 2/capsule, 3/circle (width is diameter), 0/hidden. Reflection, edge and light retain EffOnly meanings. Same nonzero group joins; group 0 isolates. transition seconds (0 snaps), spring Hz-like rate, damping ratio, pull gain, drag 0/1, quality pixel step 1–4. Component settings live here, never in helper source. The main loop must keep LG advance + LG render running; demo calls are examples and may be replaced.

M*.text: Translation follows the target normally. Deformation uses separate horizontal and vertical pull channels, never a rotated or sheared axis. Pure horizontal/vertical motion retains stretch plus reciprocal cross-squeeze. Cross-squeeze fades when the other axis also moves, so diagonal movement combines both stretches instead of cancelling them. Scales are capped at 1.65; both sides change equally and relax after release.

OA.text: One rounded-box contour covers all shapes. Centered pull maps x to scaleX*x and y to scaleY*y only. There are no off-diagonal terms: rectangles stay level, circles stay axis-aligned ellipses, and capsules cannot tilt or shear. Opposite sides are symmetric. Inverse coordinates and inverse-transpose normals deform the contour, rim and refraction together; configured width/height stay unchanged.

O{.text: Cache active IDs, stable group anchors, optical bands and double-angle light vectors once per frame. Group 0 and join 0 each isolate their component. Other matching groups fold in ascending component-ID order. Pair bounds include conservative 2 × pull amplitude padding; strength fades as centers coincide. No per-pixel trigonometry or individual-normal gate is needed.

Rl.text: Each nonzero joining group is one continuous sequential smooth union, with stable ascending-ID order. All seven optical properties follow EXACTLY the same fold weight as its distance. Pair position gates combine continuously into each new member's reach; no winning pair can switch its material abruptly at a three-way junction. Distinct groups, group 0 and join 0 use hard union. Two-member groups retain the previous bounded polynomial union exactly.

SX.text: Standalone field query: refresh cached geometry then sample. LG render calls LG prepare once and uses LG sample for each pixel instead.

S%.text: Two passes: compute merged field once per grid point, then shade its finite-difference normal. Pixel step 1 is highest detail; 2 is balanced. Bounds are clipped to the stage. Sampling clamps BOTH coordinates before indexing, avoiding EffOnly row wrap. Background RGB and displayed costume are always the same source. Only standard Pen is used.

UW.text: EffOnly optical profile toward the interior normal; reflection 0.5, edge 1, light -30 preserve defaults. A smooth optical gain suppresses refraction where merged normals cancel. Per-pixel optical values come from the SAME n-ary fold as geometry, so three-way joins do not switch winning pairs. Double-angle light vectors reconstruct and continuously mix the original opposing lobes without per-pixel trigonometry. Materials and rims follow the merged boundary.

Wn.text: Demo target values for the keyboard controls. The three PUBLIC Glass calls are directly in the green-flag forever loop. Edit those calls to customize components; helpers never need hard-coded changes.

WC.text: One-shot demo setup helper, also used by validation. The main green-flag loop contains its own visible Glass calls.

M!.text: START HERE • Edit Background, Button and Menu in the green-flag loop. G switches to/from the original Glass demo. Buttons activate on release; menu paths use | between choices and > between levels.
